title: fix(setUiState): call onStateChange handler
body:
<!--
  Thanks for submitting a pull request!
  Please provide enough information so that others can review your pull request.
-->

**Summary**

When calling setUiState, the onStateChange function should also be called, so that it can be used to keep track of state changes from any source. However, we need to make sure that onStateChange itself doesn't cause infinite loops of course!

<!--
  Explain the **motivation** for making this change.
  What existing problem does the pull request solve?
  Are there any linked issues?
-->

**Result**

- onStateChange is also called for setUiState
- a new (private) argument to setUiState is added to allow avoiding calling onStateChange

This could be considered a breaking change, as before this fix onStateChange wasn't called when you are using InstantSearch.setUiState, but I don't see how that could cause issues. Middleware's onStateChange already was called before this PR
